title: 亚洲资金不再只买治疗：转向有收入的美国医疗公司，还要叠加AI
speaker: Alvin Leo

segments.en: However, we are seeing a lot of demand, especially from this part of the world, a different kind of exposure.
segments.zh: 然而，我们看到大量需求，尤其是来自这个地区，一种不同类型的敞口。

segments.en: I think historically, if you look at investors based in Asia, they've always been interested in US healthcare, but the opportunities they were exposed to are mainly therapeutics and medical devices.
segments.zh: 我认为从历史上看，亚洲的出资方一直对美国医疗健康感兴趣，但他们接触到的机会主要是治疗和医疗器械。

segments.en: And oftentimes, they had to underwrite essentially a binary financial outcome.
segments.zh: 而且他们往往不得不承销本质上是二元的财务结果。

segments.en: What we're hearing from this part of the world and the US are access and exposure to private US healthcare companies that are revenue generating and have more predictable commercial business models. And that's why the picks and shuffles opportunities are compelling.
segments.zh: 我们从该地区和美国的出资方那里听到的是，他们希望接触和配置有收入、商业模式更可预测的美国私营医疗健康公司。这就是为什么卖铲人机会如此有吸引力。

segments.en: When and if you add AI on top of it, it's another dimension, because as I mentioned, the US healthcare sector is incredibly large, which really allows for a very deep ecosystem of companies that sell services, technology and life science tools to large enterprise pool of spending,
segments.zh: 如果再叠加AI，那就是另一个维度，因为正如我提到的，美国医疗健康板块极其庞大，允许一个非常深厚的生态系统，向大型企业支出池销售服务、技术和生命科学工具，

segments.en: which is integrated hospital systems, pharmaceutical companies and payers.
segments.zh: 这些企业支出池包括整合型医院系统、制药公司和支付方。

segments.en: So essentially, by combining these two investors in this part of the world and in US, have access and exposure to very big investment thesis, which is the modernization of US healthcare sector and monetization of AI.
segments.zh: 所以本质上，通过结合这两者，该地区和美国的出资方能够接触和配置一个非常大的主题，即美国医疗健康板块的现代化和AI的商业化。
